summary: Form 6-K filing by Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd. announces receipt of $43 million in additional orders for Sidewinder ESA terminals from an in-flight connectivity service provider. The orders are for deliveries over 18 months in line-fit and retrofit configurations. The filing is a routine business update, not a special situation. No financial terms, premiums, or structural changes are disclosed. It reflects ongoing commercial momentum and technology adoption, but does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. This is an ordinary operational announcement.
